style: Swiss-editorial showreel. Hard graphic colour fields, heavy grotesk type, mono HUD, film grain. Every scene demonstrates one craft principle and hands off to the next with a different transition (bar-expand, iris, square wipe, hard cut + glitch, whip spin).
font: Archivo Black + League Gothic + JetBrains Mono

scenes.motion: dot drop with squash/stretch, line sweep, masked letter rise, bar expands into colour field

scenes.text: MOTION IS TIMING / WEIGHT / TENSION / FEELING
scenes.motion: slot word swap, each word with its own ease; live ease-curve graph draws the ease in use; rider dot becomes iris
16x9 shape grid, centre-out stagger, circle-to-diamond morph, wave, implode, square wipe
count-up, 30-tick film strip fill, slam + shake, RGB glitch into hard cut
3D drum ticks through the 12 principles of animation, parallax side drums, whip spin with blur
masked wordmark rise, the dot from scene 1 returns as the full stop with a bounce, shockwave, hold
